# Kitt native layout DLL (src/windows)
#
# Builds kittua.dll from the generated KBDTABLES source
# (kitt_tables.c). This file is boring on purpose: no installer
# logic, no logging framework, no network, no mutable app state
# (see KITT_ARCHITECTURE.md section 8 "Native layer should NOT
# contain").
#
# kitt_tables.c is GENERATED by `python -m kittgen generate` from
# layout/kitt.uk-UA.yaml. Do not hand-edit it; this CMakeLists.txt
# only compiles it.

set(KITT_DLL_SOURCES
    kitt_tables.c
)

add_library(kittua SHARED
    ${KITT_DLL_SOURCES}
    resources.rc
)

# Windows keyboard-layout DLLs are identified by Windows via their
# exports (KbdLayerDescriptor), not by a particular file extension,
# but ".dll" is the standard/expected output type.
set_target_properties(kittua PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "kittua"
    SUFFIX ".dll"
)

# kbd.h (Windows Driver Kit keyboard-layout header) lives under the
# Windows SDK's "um" include directory alongside windows.h/shared.
# On a normal Windows SDK install CMake's own FindWindowsSDK/toolchain
# integration already exposes these via the MSVC environment
# (INCLUDE/LIB), so this is a defensive fallback for the case where
# the generator/toolchain is invoked outside a fully initialized
# vcvars shell.
if(DEFINED ENV{WindowsSdkDir} AND DEFINED ENV{WindowsSDKVersion})
    string(STRIP "$ENV{WindowsSDKVersion}" _kitt_sdk_version)
    string(REGEX REPLACE "\\\\$" "" _kitt_sdk_version "${_kitt_sdk_version}")
    target_include_directories(kittua PRIVATE
        "$ENV{WindowsSdkDir}Include/${_kitt_sdk_version}/um"
        "$ENV{WindowsSdkDir}Include/${_kitt_sdk_version}/shared"
    )
endif()

target_link_libraries(kittua PRIVATE kernel32)

# Windows keyboard-layout DLLs export a single well-known entry
# point (KbdLayerDescriptor) via a .def file rather than
# __declspec(dllexport) alone, matching the standard WDK keyboard-
# layout sample convention referenced in
# KITT_ARCHITECTURE.md section 4.
if(MSVC)
    target_link_options(kittua PRIVATE "/DEF:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/kitt.def")
endif()

# Kitt targets Windows x64 only for v1 (KITT_ARCHITECTURE.md
# section 23).
if(NOT CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 8)
    message(WARNING "Kitt v1 targets Windows x64; building for a non-64-bit target is unsupported.")
endif()

install(TARGETS kittua
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
    LIBRARY DESTINATION bin
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
)
